articles.title: Dugarry slams De Zerbi’s Tottenham contract: ‘A robbery without a mask’
articles.summary: Christophe Dugarry has taken aim at Roberto De Zerbi, questioning whether the Italian is equipped for a job of Tottenham’s size and suggesting his contract i...
articles.body:
Christophe Dugarry has taken aim at Roberto De Zerbi, questioning whether the Italian is equipped for a job of Tottenham 's size and suggesting his contract is a heist.

According to Alfredo Pedullà , the former Milan , Barcelona and Marseille forward made the comments to RMC Sport. "I have never really understood what his level actually is," Dugarry said. "They tell me he did well at Brighton , Sassuolo and other clubs, but for me he is still not an absolute guarantee for coaching the big teams."

He then turned to the length of the deal. "He signed a five-year contract. What he has done is a genuine robbery, without even needing to wear a mask. It is incredible."

LONDON, ENGLAND – APRIL 18: Roberto De Zerbi, Manager of Tottenham Hotspur during the Premier League match between Tottenham Hotspur and Brighton & Hove Albion at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on April 18, 2026 in London, England. (Photo by Alex Pantling/Getty Images)

De Zerbi still waiting for a first league goal at Tottenham this season

The timing is unhelpful for the Italian. Spurs have taken two points from four Premier League matches and are yet to score, a run now stretching beyond 400 minutes, with back-to-back goalless draws against Nottingham Forest and Everton . The latter ended with the home crowd booing his players off at full-time .

That record sits awkwardly against a summer outlay of roughly €350m, which is the real source of the scrutiny rather than the contract itself.

SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA – JULY 29: Tottenham coach, Roberto De Zerbi reacts during the Sydney Super Cup match between Sydney FC and Tottenham Hotspur at Allianz Stadium on July 29, 2026 in Sydney, Australia. (Photo by Brendon Thorne/Getty Images)

De Zerbi's teams have historically needed time to settle, and the ideas that earned him admirers at Sassuolo and Brighton were never quick fixes. But four games without a goal in the league this season buys very little patience anywhere, and none at all at a club that has changed manager as often as Tottenham have.

articles.title: Official | Dino Toppmoller leaves RC Lens by mutual consent
articles.summary: RC Lens and Dino Toppmoller have parted ways by mutual agreement, it was confirmed on Tuesday. The German, hired to replace Pierre Sage over the summer, only...
articles.body:
RC Lens and Dino Toppmoller have parted ways by mutual agreement, it was confirmed on Tuesday. The German, hired to replace Pierre Sage over the summer, only took charge of six official games before his departure.

Toppmoller beat Paris Saint-Germain in the Trophée des Champions and also won Lens' UEFA Champions League opener against Slavia Prague last week. He also took charge of four games in Ligue 1, with the club currently sitting in 10th with just one win in that time.

Announcing the departure of the former Eintracht Frankfurt manager, Lens explained that the end of their collaboration is due to the club's restructuring plans. Toppmoller did not share the same vision as his executives on this matter, and so the decision was taken to part ways. The manager will also depart with the two assistants who joined him at the Bollaert this summer.

Lens announced that it will be Yannick Cahuzac who will take charge of their game against AS Monaco on Friday.

articles.title: VAR audio of Erling Haaland’s controversial Manchester derby winner released
articles.summary: Howard Webb, Pro Ref’s chief refereering officer, admitted that the officials did not notice Fernandez’s offside offence because they had ‘tunnel vision’
articles.body:
The VAR officials who were in charge of Sunday's Manchester derby failed to check whether Manchester City midfielder Enzo Fernandez was interfering with play for Erling Haaland 's controversial winner against Manchester United , it has been revealed.

Appearing on the Premier League 's Mic'd Up show, referees' boss Howard Webb said the officials had "tunnel vision" and became "super focused" on assessing whether Haaland was onside, rather than also considering whether Fernandez was committing an offside offence.

Haaland's goal was awarded after the striker was found to be just onside, but referees' body Pro Ref said on Sunday night that an "error of judgement" had been made after the role of Fernandez, who made an attempt to touch the ball in the box from an offside position, was not considered.

VAR Matt Donohue and his assistant Blake Antrobus have been stood down from this weekend's fixtures and Webb, the former Premier League referee and Pro Ref's chief refereeing officer, said it was "really disappointing" that neither official checked whether Fernandez was interfering.

"We felt it was important that we acknowledged an error in the situation," Webb said. "We know that Erling Haaland was penalised for offside and wasn't in an offside position. We also know that Enzo Fernandez , who was in an offside position, almost certainly interfered with the Manchester United defence and probably the goalkeeper.

"I was really disappointed with this outcome, we all were, none more than the officials. They take personal pride in what they do and they are hurting now after falling short in this situation. They will not be officiating until after the international break.

"We have reached out to Manchester United and acknowledged the error, as we do when these things happen and they do not happen often. We want to ensure we are transparent and open.

"We have played the audio and footage to the club to let them know what happened. We will review the situation to understand what elements of the process fell down in this situation which meant we didn't get to the right outcome."

Assistant VAR [ Blake Antrobus] : Enzo, Enzo.

Assistant referees [ Stuart Burt and Tim Wood] : I'm going to go offside, Haaland.

VAR: Checking the on-field decision of offside against Haaland. He's tight. He's onside, so now we need to check the full attacking possession phase (APP).

Michael, Haaland's in an onside position, but I need to check the full APP now, standby. Go back to check if [Iliman] Ndiaye is onside when it is flicked. Quick, quick. Yes it's fine, so it should be a goal. Let's go, go, go

No touch there [from Enzo Fernandez], confirm no touch. Clear gap. It's not a touch there is it? Goal. Michael, confirming that you need to change your decision to goal. Haaland is in an onside position. Final decision is goal. Check complete.

Even though Fernandez did not touch the ball, the Manchester City midfielder should still have been penalised for one of a number of offside infringements that impacted Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez and goalkeeper Senne Lammens .

However Webb explained that the VAR officials were too busy checking whether Haaland was offside that they forgot whether to assess how Fernandez was impacting play from an offside position.

Webb added: "We see Fernandez dive towards the ball and he gets close to it. That impacts Martinez - he cannot come and clear the ball. It probably impacts Lammens as well, he cannot dive in the way he would or sets himself for potential contact from Fernandez. It is impacting the defence in a couple of ways as a result of the actions he makes in the offside position.

"The on-field decision was not against Fernandez, it was against Haaland. When the VAR starts their check, they see that Haaland is actually onside by three centimetres. The VAR gets super focused on Haaland. He establishes he is onside but when he runs it through the full APP, he doesn't truly evaluate the full impact of Fernandez.

"In that moment, he gets tunnel vision but it is down to the rest of his team to pull him out of that tunnel but unfortunately, that did not happen on this occasion. This goal should have been disallowed."

articles.title: Trell Harris injury update: OU football WR out for foreseeable future

articles.body:
NORMAN — Oklahoma wide receiver Trell Harris will miss some time.

Harris, a transfer from Virginia , took a ferocious hit in the second quarter of the Sooners ' loss to Michigan . He finished the rest of the game, totaling four catches for 43 yards.

"He's still being evaluated," Sooners coach Brent Venables said. "He's going to be out for the foreseeable future."

Harris previously underwent a cleanup procedure during the offseason, causing him to miss spring camp. He returned to the field during preseason training camp and was expected to be one of OU's most impactful playmakers this season.

In his absence, increased playing time is likely coming for Washington State transfer Mackenzie Alleyne, Texas transfer Parker Livingstone and second-year player Manny Choice. Elijah Thomas will likely see more targets as well.

"Excited about those guys," Venables said. "They've shown enough to give you great confidence in what they'll do, maybe in an expanded role. Elijah Thomas is one of our most explosive guys, we've got to get him more involved more so than he is. ... Mackenzie might have been the most productive guy all spring."

Harris played in all 13 games for the Cavaliers last season, registering 59 receptions for 847 yards and five touchdowns. Across two games as a Sooner, Harris has six catches for 104 yards and a touchdown.

articles.body:
This season, GametimeCT debuts its weekly girls soccer power rankings. We have a full week of games, plus recent past history to make determinations who we think belong in the top 10.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not a media poll, nor a Connecticut coaches poll, which GametimeCT runs weekly . It is determined by girls soccer writer Joe Morelli each week. If you are a veteran girls soccer coach or fan, the choices may not come as a surprise. But the order might.

Greenwich surprised a lot of people by winning its first CIAC championship in its first appearance. And until proven otherwise, the Cardinals are No. 1. St. Joseph did beat Greenwich in last year's FCIAC championship in penalty kicks before losing in the Class LL second round at New Canaan .

Amity and Mercy will play one another again this season, so we should get an idea which team is better. Amity reached the Class LL final last season and Mercy beat St. Joseph in the final second in the 2024 LL championship game. Simsbury, which dropped into Class L this season, rounds out the top five.

Notre Dame Prep, the reigning SWC tournament champion , is sixth, followed by Ridgefield, Farmington, North Haven and Staples.

articles.title: Iza desvela que casi llega a las manos con Agné en el Zaragoza y eso le costó el puesto
articles.standfirst: El técnico fue destituido al día siguiente del enfrentamiento con el lateral
articles.summary: El técnico fue destituido al día siguiente del enfrentamiento con el lateral
articles.body: Isaac Carcelén, que se ha retirado este verano del fútbol, ha desvelado una sorprendente anécdota que vivió en su etapa en el Real Zaragoza hace ya una década. El defensa, según ha contado en el podcast Offsiders, contó que estuvo a punto de llegar a las manos con Raúl Agné, técnico blanquillo de aquel momento, y eso le costó el puesto al entrenador al día siguiente. Todo ocurrió en la charla posterior a una derrota con el filial del Sevilla: "Entró al vestuario muy enfadado y la tomaba siempre con los más jóvenes. Irurete empezó a reirse y me dijo "¿De qué cojones te estás riendo? A ti te digo. Le contesté que yo no me había reído, que estaba callado. Fue entonces cuando me amenazó con darme una guantá. Y yo, de perdidos al río, le digo 'pues ven pa' acá', a mí este no me va a hacer bullying. Yo te miro a los ojos como me miras tú a mí y si me tengo que pegar contigo a puñetazos, pues me peleo". El capitán Alberto Zapater tuvo que intervenir para separarlos e Iza, entre lloros, acudió después tanto al ejeano como a los otros dos capitanes Cani y José Enrique: "Sois los capitanes, habéis jugado en equipazos y tenéis la vida resuelta. Yo estoy empezando, no podéis dejar que un entrenador le haga esto a un chaval. Tienes que coger y echarlo, esto no es así". El andaluz le comunicó lo sucedido a su agente que llamó inmediatamente al director deportivo, Lalo Arantegui, que acababa de entrar por Narciso Juliá: "No se lo creía y le dijo que hablase con los capitanes. Al día siguiente fue destituído. En la despedida le di la mano pero vamos, sin mirarle a la cara. Menos mal que no me he encontrado más a ese tío en mi carrera deportiva". Iza también habló de la situación actual del Real Zaragoza: "Hay chavales ahí cobrando muy poco dinero para la presión que le están metiendo. La gente se piensa allí que el Real Zaragoza tiene una historia, que es un club grande de España, es de los cinco con más títulos de España... Pero la afición se tiene que dar cuenta qué es lo que hay ahora mismo. Y tienen que pegar un cambio de chip, sino ese equipo pinta muy mal. O hacen ese cambio de chip o se las van a ver muy canutas también Primera RFEF". Y puso la lupa sobre los jugadores como él que fuera sí han funcionado: "Yo siempre digo que ningún jugador vale en el Real Zaragoza. Qué casualidad que todos juegan en Primera o firman en equipos top. Y en el Real Zaragoza no valían. Yo creo que se lo tienen que hacer mirar un poco y no meterle tanta presión a los jugadores. Dejarles fluir. Al final, firman muy buenos jugadores allí. El que juegue en el Real Zaragoza puede jugar en cualquier club. La presión ya la lleva. Yo te digo que puede llegar a jugar hasta en el Real Madrid o en el Barcelona, fácil"

articles.summary: "Nosotros teníamos conocimiento de que ese aviso se había recibido el viernes, pero en la Consejería decían que no y en cuanto dijeron que se recibió el lunes, ya por la tarde nos dieron el beneplácito", ha asegurado en Movistar LaLiga
articles.body: José María Sardá, vicepresidente del Rayo Vallecano, se refirió en Movistar LaLiga a la situación del club que disputará ante el Espanyol su último encuentro lejos de su estadio, una vez que la Comunidad levantase la suspensión de Vallecas. Se podría haber jugado este partido en Vallecas: "Sí, porque en realidad podríamos haberlo jugado en Vallecas, aunque la resolución llegó ayer por la tarde y no daba tiempo material, pero sí se podía haber jugado, porque se podía haber hecho antes esto. Nosotros teníamos conocimiento de que ese aviso se había recibido el viernes, pero en la Consejería decían que no y en cuanto dijeron que se recibió el lunes, ya por la tarde nos dieron el beneplácito. Nosotros no hemos mentido, las cosas iban como y iban". Estado del césped para haber jugado hoy: "El césped estaba en condiciones para jugar, pero al no avisarnos para jugar se empezó con el cambio de césped de verano a invierno". Después del parón ya jugarán con seguridad en casa: "Estoy totalmente seguro de que se va a jugar en Vallecas. Tenemos contrato hasta el año 39 y con una ampliación de 10 años más. Ese partido se va a jugar en Vallecas y los siguientes también. A la afición quiero decirle que ya ha pasado este mal trago, que lamentamos mucho esta situación que se ha ido de nuestras manos, pero nosotros siempre hacemos y deseamos lo mejor para el club". Habrá compensación para la afición por estos tres partidos que no se han jugado en Vallecas: "Lo tenemos que ver y algo se podrá hacer".
